verdict.rationale: Ardent's safety model for agents is isolation, not scoped tools. Agents get a full Postgres branch URL and run raw SQL against a disposable copy, so destructive actions are harmless to production. Nothing in the evidence shows agent-facing SQL or schema tools that separate read-only from destructive actions. The read-only API role (role_org_viewer) and the connector deletion lock govern Ardent's management plane, not the agent's database operations, so both are adjacent controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run SQL and schema operations through scoped tools that distinguish read-only from destructive actions, so I can safely delegate database work
